legalDraftBannerBody:
The text below is an initial draft prepared for internal review. It has not been reviewed by a lawyer, it is not a final document, and it must not be relied on as legal advice.
Every value written in square brackets, for example [LEGAL_ENTITY_NAME], is a placeholder that has to be filled in. The whole document must be reviewed and approved by a qualified lawyer before the service opens to real customers.
legalEffectiveDate: Effective date: [EFFECTIVE_DATE]. This draft is not yet in effect.
privacyIntroBody:
Keepqueue is an online appointment booking and management service for small service businesses in Israel, such as barbershops, salons and clinics.
The controller of the personal data described in this notice is [LEGAL_ENTITY_NAME], company number [COMPANY_REGISTRATION_NUMBER], of [REGISTERED_ADDRESS], Israel. Questions about this notice, or about data held about you, can be sent to [CONTACT_EMAIL].
The service is currently offered as a free pilot: there is no payment, no subscription and no pricing plan, and we do not collect payment details of any kind.
privacyDataBody:
Account details you provide when you register, or that a business provides for you: first and last name, email address and phone number.
Appointment data created as you use the service: the business and the service booked, the date and time, the status of the appointment (booked, confirmed, cancelled, completed, no-show), and notes a business adds to an appointment.
Business-side data: business name, address, description, opening hours, services and prices, staff members, and the customer list linked to that business, including notes and blocking marks the business records about its customers.
Reviews and ratings you choose to publish about a business.
Technical data created automatically: sign-in timestamps, IP addresses in server logs, error and security logs, and an audit record of actions taken inside a business account — who changed what and when.
We do not collect special categories of data, such as health or biometric data, and we ask that you do not enter such data into free-text fields.
privacyPurposeBody:
To operate the service: create your account, show a business's availability, book, change and cancel appointments, and show a business its schedule and its customer list.
To send you service messages about your own appointments, such as a booking confirmation or a reminder before the appointment.
To keep the service secure and available: prevent abuse, investigate faults, and keep an audit trail of actions taken in a business account.
To meet legal obligations that apply to us.
We do not sell personal data, we do not share it for advertising, and we do not run third-party advertising or analytics trackers on the site.
privacyBasisBody:
Under the Protection of Privacy Law, 5741-1981, including Amendment 13 which came into force in August 2025, personal data is collected with the knowledge and consent of the data subject. You give that consent when you open an account or book an appointment, after reading this notice.
Some processing is necessary in order to provide the service you asked for — an appointment cannot be booked without a name, a phone number and the details of the appointment. Other processing is necessary in order to meet a legal obligation or to protect the service against abuse.
Where a business entered your details into the service, that business is responsible for the legal basis for doing so, and Keepqueue processes those details on its behalf as described below.
You are not legally obliged to give us your details, but without them the service cannot be provided.
privacySharingBody:
The business you book with. Your name, phone number, email address and appointment details are visible to that business and to its staff — that is the purpose of the service.
Google (Firebase and Google Cloud). Our database, authentication and file storage run on Google's platform, which acts as a processor on our behalf.
[HOSTING_PROVIDER] — the hosting provider that runs the Keepqueue API server.
Message delivery providers, when a confirmation or a reminder is sent to you by email or SMS. The provider receives only what is needed to deliver the message.
Authorities or professional advisers, where we are required by law to disclose, or where disclosure is necessary in order to bring or defend a legal claim.
Beyond this we do not transfer personal data to third parties.
privacyHostingBody:
The service runs on Google Cloud and Firebase infrastructure and on a hosted server. Depending on the region configured for the project, data may be stored or processed outside Israel, including in the European Union and the United States.
Transfers outside Israel are made in accordance with the Protection of Privacy Regulations (Transfer of Data to Databases Abroad) and with the contractual terms of the processors we use, which require them to protect the data at a level comparable to Israeli law.
The hosting region actually in use is [DATA_HOSTING_REGION].
privacyRetentionBody:
Account details are kept while the account is active.
Appointment records are kept for as long as they are needed to run the business and for any period required by law, and are then deleted or anonymised.
Server, error and audit logs are kept for a short operational period, up to [LOG_RETENTION_PERIOD].
When an account is deleted, the personal data linked to it is deleted or anonymised within [DELETION_PERIOD] of the request, except data we are legally required to keep.
privacyRightsBody:
You have the right to know whether we hold data about you, to receive a copy of it, and to ask that it be corrected if it is incorrect, incomplete, unclear or out of date. You may also ask us to delete data about you, subject to any legal duty to retain it.
Some of this you can do yourself: sign in and edit the details in your profile.
For any other request, write to [CONTACT_EMAIL] from the email address registered on the account. We will respond within 30 days.
Note that a business holding a record of appointments made with it is a separate controller of its own customer records, and a request about those records may need to be addressed to the business.
If you believe your rights have been infringed, you may complain to the Privacy Protection Authority at the Ministry of Justice.
privacySecurityBody:
Traffic to the site and to the API is encrypted in transit using HTTPS.
Passwords are handled by Firebase Authentication and are never stored by us in a readable form.
Access to data is restricted by identity and by role: a business account can only reach the records of the business it owns.
No system is completely secure. If a serious security incident affecting your data occurs, we will act as the law requires, including notifying the Privacy Protection Authority and the affected users where the law requires it.
privacyCookiesBody:
We use only the cookies and browser storage needed to operate the service: a cookie that remembers your interface language, a cookie that remembers whether the side menu is open, local storage that holds your display preferences, and the storage Firebase Authentication uses to keep you signed in.
We do not use advertising cookies, and we do not embed third-party analytics or tracking services.
You can delete this storage in your browser settings, but you will then be signed out and your preferences will be reset.
privacyMinorsBody: The service is intended for users aged 16 and over. Where a business books an appointment for a minor, that business is responsible for obtaining the consent of the parent or guardian. If we learn that we hold the details of a minor without such consent, we will delete them.
privacyChangesBody: We may update this notice as the service develops. The current version is always available on this page, and the date at the top of the page changes with it. A material change will be announced inside the service before it takes effect.
privacyContactBody: For any question about privacy or about this notice: [CONTACT_EMAIL], for the attention of [PRIVACY_CONTACT_NAME].
termsIntroBody:
These terms govern the use of the Keepqueue service — the website, the booking pages and the business management interface. Using the service means that you accept them. If you do not accept them, please do not use the service.
The service is operated by [LEGAL_ENTITY_NAME], company number [COMPANY_REGISTRATION_NUMBER], of [REGISTERED_ADDRESS], Israel.
termsServiceTitle: What the service is, and what the pilot is
termsServiceBody:
Keepqueue lets a service business publish its availability, and lets customers book, change and cancel appointments online.
The service is currently in a free pilot. It is provided at no charge, there is no subscription and no payment of any kind, and no payment details are collected. Because it is a pilot, features may change, be added or be removed, and there may be periods in which the service is unavailable.
During the pilot a business page is opened by us, in coordination with the business owner. Registering an owner account does not by itself create an active business page.
termsAccountsBody:
You must provide correct and current details and keep them up to date. An account is personal — do not share your password.
A business account is responsible for everything done inside it, including actions taken by its staff.
We may suspend or close an account that breaches these terms, that is used to harm other users, or that is used unlawfully.
termsBookingsTitle: The appointment is between you and the business
termsBookingsBody:
Keepqueue is a booking tool. The service itself — the haircut, the treatment, the consultation — is supplied by the business and not by us. We are not a party to the agreement between a customer and a business.
Prices, opening hours, cancellation policy, late arrival and no-shows are set by each business and shown on its page. Complaints about the service supplied, or about payment for it, should be addressed to the business.
We do not guarantee that a business will honour a booking, and we are not responsible for a business that cancels, closes or changes its opening hours.
termsUseBody:
Do not use the service to break the law, to harass anyone, or to send unsolicited commercial messages.
Do not make bookings you do not intend to keep, do not use another person's details, and do not book on someone's behalf without their consent.
Do not attempt to reach data that is not yours, do not attempt to bypass the access controls of the service, and do not scan, scrape or overload it.
Do not upload content that infringes the rights of others.
termsContentBody:
A review must reflect a real experience with the business. Do not publish false, offensive or misleading content, or content that identifies other people without their consent.
You keep the rights in the content you upload, and you permit us to display it within the service for the purpose of operating it.
A business may ask for a review to be examined, and we may remove content that breaches these terms.
termsAvailabilityBody:
The service is provided as is and subject to availability. During the pilot there is no service level commitment, no uptime guarantee and no committed response time for support requests.
We may change, suspend or discontinue the service or any part of it. If we discontinue it, notice will be given in advance inside the service and a reasonable period will be allowed for exporting data.
Do not treat the service as the only record of your business data. Keep your own copy of anything you cannot afford to lose.
termsLiabilityBody:
The service is provided free of charge during the pilot. To the maximum extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect or consequential loss, for loss of income or profit, or for damage caused by an appointment that was not honoured, by a message that failed to arrive, or by a period in which the service was unavailable.
Nothing here limits liability that cannot be limited by law, including liability for wilful misconduct.
You are responsible for the content you publish and for the use you make of the service, and you will bear the cost of a claim brought against us arising from your breach of these terms.
